Fuzzer initialization and a hash memcpy versus hash consistency check.

# Purpose
This file defines a libFuzzer entry point for testing `fd_hash_memcpy` against `fd_hash`. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) disables backtraces, starts the `fd` runtime with `fd_boot`, registers `fd_halt` with `atexit`, and sets the core log level. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) reads a `ulong` seed from the start of the input, copies the remaining bytes into a temporary buffer, and computes two hashes: one with `fd_hash_memcpy` and one with `fd_hash`. If the two results differ, it reports a critical log error with `FD_LOG_CRIT`; otherwise, it frees the buffer and returns.
